caption:
The math nobody says out loud 💳

$3,000 on a card at 22% APR, carried all year: roughly $660 in interest.

Paid in full by the due date each month: $0 in interest.

Same spending. Very different cost. (Rough math, your card's APR will vary.)

What's your card's APR? Do you know?
